subject: Pilot/POC kickoff — Redwood for support summarization
messages:
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@finova.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood POC — follow-up and kickoff details

Thanks Aditya — good call today. Quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can get the pilot moving: 

Pain points we confirmed:
- Our current in-house summarization produces inconsistent summaries for multi-turn support threads (missing root cause, inconsistent tone).
- Latency in generating summaries on peak hours (avg 900ms) is impacting CS agent workflows.
- We need strong PII controls and auditability for regulated EU customers.

Goals for the pilot (high level):
- Compare Redwood model pipeline vs current baseline on summary fidelity and hallucination rate.
- Demonstrate <500ms 95th percentile inference latency for 3k concurrent daily requests.
- Verify data controls (S3 access patterns, encryption, ACLs) and SOC2 evidence for security team.

Next steps we discussed:
1) Share a list of 200k anonymized chat records and a seed prompt set (~250 examples) for initial evals.
2) Redwood to run prompt tuning and deliver a 3-week pilot evaluation report.
3) We sign a short SOW and provide Redwood read-only access to the S3 test bucket.

Attaching the Finova internal PII policy PDF for reference (not attached here). Can you send the POC plan and the prompt set you referenced? Also confirm who will be our Redwood contacts for engineering and security.

Thanks,
Daniel
Director of Customer Ops
Finova
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@finova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood POC — follow-up and kickoff details

Daniel — thanks for the great conversation yesterday and for outlining the goals so clearly. Below is a concise POC kickoff recap and next steps so we have alignment before scheduling the formal kickoff. I've attached the POC plan (redwood_poc_plan_v1.pdf), the seed prompt set (eval_prompt_set.csv), and a draft SOW (redwood_sow_draft.docx).

POC scope (3 weeks):
- Dataset: ~200k anonymized support threads (you confirmed this is feasible). Redwood will validate anonymization on ingest.
- Use-cases: (1) multi-turn thread summarization for CS agents, (2) short customer-facing TL;DR for email responses.
- Traffic: emulate production load up to 3k daily unique requests; target 95th < 500ms.

Primary success metrics (explicit):
- Summary quality: decrease hallucination rate by >= 30% vs baseline (measured via labeled eval set).
- Accuracy/ROUGE: relative improvement of >= 15% on the seeded eval set.
- Latency: 95th percentile < 500ms on Redwood Dedicated profile for expected traffic mix.
- Operational: end-to-end integration with your S3 test bucket and ability to rotate keys via your KMS.

Prompt set / evals:
- Attached: eval_prompt_set.csv (250 labeled examples + expected outputs + fail modes).
- We'll run blind evals and provide both quantitative metrics and 20 manually-reviewed examples highlighting failure modes.
- If you want custom scoring, we can accept your rubric as a CSV and adapt the eval harness.

Owners / contacts:
- Redwood AE (commercial & coordination): Aditya Rao (me) — aditya_rao@redwood.ai
- Redwood Solutions Eng (technical lead): Marissa Cole — marissa_cole@redwood.ai
- Redwood Security & Compliance: Stephanie Nguyen — stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

Finova owners we have on the call: please confirm the following so we can provision access:
- Data owner for sample set (S3 details + contact)
- Security reviewer for SOC2 evidence requests
- Procurement contact for SOW/DocuSign sign-off

Timeline (proposed):
- Day 0 (kickoff): secure S3 read-only access, review anonymization checklist, finalize SOW.
- Week 1: data ingestion + baseline run on Redwood test profile.
- Week 2: prompt tuning, targeted evals on seed set, and iterative feedback.
- Week 3: full-scale run, manual reviews, final metric report, and go/no-go decision.

Access & setup checklist (action items for Finova):
1) Create a read-only S3 bucket and add redwood-poc@redwood.ai IAM role (we will provide the role ARN).
2) Share a sample of 1k threads (anonymized) as soon as possible for a smoke test.
3) Add Redwood IPs to your allowlist for test endpoints (details in the SOW).
4) Complete the short security questionnaire (we'll send this as a Drive link).

Attachments included: redwood_poc_plan_v1.pdf; eval_prompt_set.csv; redwood_sow_draft.docx

DocuSign link (SOW): https://redwood.app/docusign/FIN-2026-042
Drive: https://drive.google.com/finova/poc-assets

If that all looks good, propose we schedule the kickoff for Monday, Feb 23rd at 10am PT. If that doesn't work, please suggest alternate times.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@finova.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finova Legal <procurement@finova.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood POC — follow-up and kickoff details

Aditya — thanks for the thorough plan and the attachments. A few quick items from our side: 

1) Security: our security reviewer (Claire Hsu) will need the SOC2 scope and the questionnaire answers. I've looped procurement so they can review the SOW and routing for legal.
2) Data access: we'll create the test S3 bucket by EOD Friday (you'll get a role ARN to attach).
3) Timeline: Feb 23rd 10am PT works for the kickoff.

I'll confirm Claire's email and share the anonymized 1k sample by Monday AM. Procurement will review the SOW and reply within 48 hours.

One quick question: for the manual review step, can we join the review sessions remotely and access the review UI, or will you provide exportable reports?

Thanks,
Daniel
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@finova.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood POC — follow-up and kickoff details

Daniel — great, we'll plan for Feb 23rd kickoff at 10am PT. Quick answers to your question: 

- Manual review: yes, your reviewers can join the live review sessions via a secure link. We'll also provide exportable CSVs and a summary report with the 20 manually reviewed examples and our notes.
- Security artifacts: Stephanie will follow up with SOC2 scope and the security questionnaire; she'll be on the kickoff too.

Action items I'm taking now:
- Schedule the kickoff invite for Feb 23rd 10am PT and include the Zoom link (invite to follow).
- Prepare an initial smoke-run plan to validate the 1k sample within 24 hours of ingest.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
